name: Necromancer: Animate: Skeletal Archer raises three archers for 15 sec on a 30 sec cooldown (#857)
contract: Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 reads 'Animate ${$500330m1} Skeletal Archers to aid you in combat for $500330d.' with an instant cast and RecoveryTime 30000. Its only effect is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 500330 on the caster. 500330 (EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3, SpellDuration 8 = 15000 ms) summons creature 50076 and says 'Does not occupy Life Force.' The audit looked for 805040 in source, but the trigger is native and 500330 is bound to spell_ascension_necromancer_summon (rev_20260909_01_necromancer_completion.sql), whose NecromancerSummons row (500330, 0, 50076, 3) raises three Skeletal Archers with the spell's 15000 ms lifetime; Cost() gives 500330 no Life Force, so free Life Force (525004 stacks) stays at the full capacity of 2. The archers exist right after the cast, are still up 11 s later and are gone by 17 s.

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura synchronize
SETUP: no archer exists before the cast
The instant cast starts the 30 s cooldown
The archers occupy no Life Force: 2 free of 2
The archers are still up 11 s later
